column1: # The step loop, the registry, signature matching and dispatch — exercised
# through ONE fixture word so no word library is needed. `addq` is declared
# Integer Integer -> Integer, forward-collecting, exactly as the eng/spec
# --- bare literals reach the residual unchanged ---

column3: a lone literal is the result
multiple residual values are the result, in order
forward collection: the word takes the two following literals
stack form: the same word over the two preceding values
two independent dispatches leave two residuals
an under-supplied call must not silently succeed (REFERENCE.md:1071 — signature_error is the RUNTIME code; no_signature is the check-mode diagnostic)
a type mismatch selects no overload
an unbound word is an error, not a value
a paren group collapses to its result
a nested group supplies an argument
